name: What types of housing solutions are available for multigenerational families?

mainEntity.name: What types of housing solutions are available for multigenerational families?

acceptedAnswer.text: Multigenerational housing solutions range from accessory dwelling units (ADUs) and detached guest houses to custom homes with integrated suites or separate living areas. ADUs, often called granny flats or in-law units, provide independent living spaces on the same property as the main house. Other options include converting existing garages or basements into self-contained apartments. The best solution depends on your family's specific needs, privacy preferences, local zoning regulations, and budget. Each option aims to provide both communal space and individual privacy.
acceptedAnswer.description: Solutions include accessory dwelling units (ADUs), detached guest houses, or custom homes with integrated suites, offering independent living spaces on the same property.
